//: Workspace settings that make Copilot materially better in this repo.
//instructions: Point Copilot at the layer rules for code generation. These stack with .github/copilot-instructions.md.
//tests: Tell Copilot how tests are written here, so /tests output matches the house style.
//review: Same rules the reviewer chat mode uses.
//commit: Keep generated commit messages imperative and scoped.

github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Imperative mood, max 72-char subject. Prefix with the area touched: backend:, frontend:, copilot:, docs:. Explain why, not what.

//editor: Strict formatting keeps generated code consistent with existing code, which in turn improves later suggestions.
//search: Keep build output out of Copilot's context window.
